rules.end_user_surface: Normal users start from the WPF app and validated app-surface records, not raw audit folders.
rules.custom_value_surface: Custom registry value experiments remain Contributor Lab / research observations unless ready_for_bounded_app_card is positive and all gates stay clean. operator96 is a legacy file/campaign ID, not product branding.
rules.cleanup: Do not delete archived/raw evidence unless the cleanup quarantine ledger reports live_reference_count=0 and a replacement or explicit obsolete reason exists. Use the retained inventory plan to reduce references before deletion.
rules.performance_claims: No benchmark/performance claim ships from a single noisy, low-confidence, or community-only observation.

artifacts.purpose: Source of shipped app-card registry surfaces.
artifacts.use_when: You need to know which cards normal users may see.
artifacts.avoid_when: You are evaluating unshipped custom registry value experiments or raw experiment records.

artifacts.purpose: Checks public repo hygiene, app-surface resolution, evidence surfaces, rollback stories, and KVM smoke references.
artifacts.use_when: Before manual app retest or after changing cards/evidence/rollback mapping.
artifacts.avoid_when: You need a per-card live apply report; use promoted-app-qa instead.

artifacts.purpose: Verifies shipped card snapshots expose required trust fields and proof lanes.
artifacts.use_when: After changing card copy, evidence drawer data, or app-surface records.
artifacts.avoid_when: You need to prove registry mutation works; use promoted-app-qa.

artifacts.purpose: Newest live VM app harness batch for promoted apply/verify/rollback cards.
artifacts.use_when: You need evidence that a representative shipped-card batch still applies and rolls back.
artifacts.avoid_when: You need total coverage across every card; use promoted-app-qa-coverage.

artifacts.purpose: Cumulative app-QA coverage summary over promoted app-card candidates.
artifacts.use_when: You need to know whether any promoted app-QA category remains uncovered.
artifacts.avoid_when: You need newest run detail; use promoted-app-qa-live-batch.

artifacts.purpose: Host-safe lookup for one tweak, value name, path, or expected value.
artifacts.use_when: A user asks whether a key/value exists, is read, or is written by the app.
artifacts.avoid_when: You need live app mutation; use check_single_tweak_app_qa.py or KVM app QA.

artifacts.purpose: Low-noise aggregate for custom registry value experiments. The file keeps the legacy operator96 artifact name for compatibility only.
artifacts.use_when: You need to know whether noisy/non-ok reruns remain.
artifacts.avoid_when: You are building normal end-user app cards.

artifacts.purpose: Explains why custom registry value experiment records remain Contributor Lab observations instead of normal cards.
artifacts.use_when: You need to decide whether any user-supplied key/value experiment may enter app cards.
artifacts.avoid_when: You want an optimization claim; this review blocks unbounded claims.

artifacts.purpose: Review-inventory safety ledger for stale reports, raw traces, old parses, and staging bundles. Only delete-candidate rows are deletion candidates.
artifacts.use_when: Before deleting or moving any archived/raw evidence or historical parse artifact.
artifacts.avoid_when: You are looking for shipped app state; use app-surface/readiness artifacts.

artifacts.purpose: Action plan for retained cleanup inventory that is not currently delete-eligible.
artifacts.use_when: After the quarantine ledger reports retained inventory and you need to reduce references or decide explicit retention.
artifacts.avoid_when: You need the deletion safety contract itself; use cleanup-quarantine-ledger.

artifacts.use_when: Before ETW, Ghidra, app deploy smoke, or registry mutation experiments.
artifacts.avoid_when: You need historical VM incident context.

artifacts.purpose: Latest self-contained publish, VM upload, expand, launch, and crash-log smoke.
artifacts.use_when: After WPF/app-shell changes or before manual app retesting.

artifacts.purpose: Latest self-contained VM launch smoke for the gated Contributor Lab startup path.
artifacts.use_when: After Contributor Lab, startup navigation, or contributor readiness UI changes.
artifacts.avoid_when: You need normal end-user card apply/rollback evidence.

artifacts.purpose: Frozen closure story for rejected/deprecated records.
artifacts.use_when: You need to understand why rejected does not mean evidence missing.
artifacts.avoid_when: You are looking for active backlog.

artifacts.purpose: Zero-pending checkpoint for the v36 classification campaign.
artifacts.use_when: You need the historical clean-state audit snapshot.
artifacts.avoid_when: You need today's app/VM retest state.
